tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Germanic ermen, 'whole, universal', a short form of names such as Ermengarde. Its root is Germanic ermen. A common Christian name in Europe since the medieval period. Emma is a Germanic name meaning “Whole; universal”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
